label: Catholic
description: Reads with the Catholic canon, the sacraments, the Church Fathers and the teaching office of the Church.

label: Protestant / Reformed
description: Reads through Reformation emphases such as grace alone, faith alone, covenant and the clarity of Scripture.

label: Orthodox
description: Reads within the Eastern Orthodox liturgical and patristic tradition, with attention to deification and mystery.

label: Historical-critical
description: Asks about the historical setting, literary sources, redaction and the world behind the text, without confessional commitment.

label: Jewish
description: Reads the text within Jewish scripture, interpretation and practice, often highlighting covenantal and communal dimensions.

label: Evangelical
description: Highlights personal conversion, the authority of Scripture, evangelism and a living relationship with Christ.

label: Anglican
description: Reads with the Book of Common Prayer, the Anglican via media and the interplay of Scripture, reason and tradition.

label: Lutheran
description: Reads through the distinction of law and gospel, justification by faith and the theology of the cross.

label: Baptist
description: Emphasises personal faith, believer's baptism, congregational life and the priesthood of all believers.

label: Methodist / Wesleyan
description: Reads with Wesleyan emphases on prevenient grace, sanctification and social holiness.

label: Pentecostal / Charismatic
description: Reads with attention to the Holy Spirit, spiritual gifts, renewal and the empowering presence of God.

label: Adventist
description: Reads with Seventh-day Adventist emphases on the Sabbath, the sanctuary, health and the blessed hope.

label: Messianic
description: Reads the whole Bible with Jewish context and practice while confessing Jesus as Messiah.

label: Liberation
description: Asks how the text confronts oppression and calls communities toward justice, solidarity and liberation.

label: Feminist
description: Attends to women, gender, power and overlooked voices in the text and its interpretation.

label: Literary
description: Reads the passage as literature: structure, imagery, narrative technique, rhetoric and intertextuality.

label: Secular / skeptic
description: Reads without religious commitment, asking about human authorship, ethics, power and natural explanations.

label: Devotional
description: Reads for prayer, consolation and personal formation, in the tradition of lectio divina.
